source.reviewMethod: Visual inspection of frames throughout the recording, with additional frames at prompts, responses, and expanded logs. Audio was not reviewed.

scope: Supporting visual evidence only. This record does not replace observed routing traces or establish backend authorization, account state, source correctness, memory settings, or synthetic-data provenance.

toolLogEvidence.conclusion: The expanded logs inspected show ordinary audit records. Tool names and argument names are visible, but values needed to reconstruct authoritative routing traces are absent. Some records are collapsed and some calls originate from the widget, so the complete model-selected sequence is not established.
